subject.title: Telegram /reasoning stream can leave replies stuck after send_attempt_started and chat.history burst

question: Should this remain the distinct Telegram `/reasoning stream` plus `chat.history` pressure issue, or be folded into the broader Telegram ambiguous-send recovery work?
rationale: Source evidence supports a shared ambiguous-send recovery gap, but this report adds a reasoning-preview trigger and Control UI history pressure that the broader guarded-lane issue does not fully own.

options.title: Track Distinct Reasoning/History Work
options.body: Keep this issue open as the proving case for reasoning preview/final delivery and decide separately whether `chat.history` needs throttling or debouncing.

options.title: Fold Into Telegram Recovery
options.body: Treat the reasoning and history details as symptoms and track the remaining recovery behavior through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91456.

options.title: Split UI History
options.body: Use this issue for Telegram ambiguous-send recovery and track the `chat.history` latency burst in a separate UI/Gateway item if maintainers want distinct ownership.

recommendation.title: Track Distinct Reasoning/History Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the proving case for reasoning preview/final delivery and decide separately whether `chat.history` needs throttling or debouncing.

likelyOwner.reason: The current source and blame evidence put the shared recovery guard, Telegram adapter declaration, and UI history loader in the recent refactor he authored.
